+def order_bank(bank, at):
+    conn = ledger.open_db(bank["path"])
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("1.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-02"))
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("2.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-03"))
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("3.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-04"))
+    conn.close()
+    return f"/api/accounts/{bank['eur'].id}/statement?from=2026-05-02&to=2026-05-31"
+
+
+def test_statement_newest_first(bank, at):
+    url = order_bank(bank, at)
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    lines = client.get(url + "&order=desc").json()["lines"]
+    assert [line["amount"] for line in lines] == ["3.00", "2.00", "1.00"]
+
+
+def test_statement_default_order_is_oldest_first(bank, at):
+    url = order_bank(bank, at)
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    lines = client.get(url).json()["lines"]
+    assert [line["amount"] for line in lines] == ["1.00", "2.00", "3.00"]
+
+
